svg.title: Checkout platform components: Component diagram for the Checkout platform, with the payment retry change marked
svg.desc: Component diagram for the Checkout platform, with the payment retry change marked. 27 elements: Shopper (person), Checkout platform (software system), Storefront (container), Checkout page (component), Basket store (component), API gateway (container), Session auth (component), Order routes (component), Order service (container), Order API (component), Order saga (component, changed), Retry scheduler (component, removed), Order repository (component), Event outbox (component), Payment service (container), Payment API (component, changed), Idempotency store (component, added), Stripe client (component, affected), Inventory service (container), Reservation engine (component), Notification worker (container), Event consumer (component), Email templates (component), Orders database (data store), Order events (queue), Stripe (external software system), Postmark (external software system). 22 relationships: Shopper to Checkout page: Enters address and card details; Checkout page to Basket store: Reads the basket; Checkout page to Session auth: Posts the order; Session auth to Order routes: Passes authenticated calls; Order routes to Order API: Places and reads orders; Order API to Order saga: Starts checkout; Order API to Order repository: Loads orders; Order saga to Reservation engine: Reserves stock; Order saga to Payment API: Authorises payment with an idempotency key (changed); Retry scheduler to Payment API: Retried failed authorisations (removed); Retry scheduler to Order repository: Scanned for stuck orders (removed); Order saga to Order repository: Saves order state; Order saga to Event outbox: Records order events; Order repository to Orders database: Reads and writes orders; Event outbox to Order events: Publishes order events; Payment API to Idempotency store: Looks up and stores key outcomes (added); Idempotency store to Orders database: Reads and writes payment keys (added); Payment API to Stripe client: Authorises and captures; Stripe client to Stripe: Creates payment intents; Order events to Event consumer: Delivers order events; Event consumer to Email templates: Renders the email for an event; Email templates to Postmark: Sends order emails.
svg.text: Component diagram for the Checkout platform, with the payment retry change marked
